description: Build a read-only itemized CAD quote (motor + installation + propeller + trade-in + HST + financing tier) and return a deep-link URL the customer can open. Do not send contact details. A nonempty contact block is rejected. To store a lead, call submit_quote_lead with consent=true. Annotations are hints, not authorization.

customer_has_propeller.description: True: reuse, subject to fit checks. False: include allowance. Omitted: reuse for same-HP Mercury trade, otherwise allowance. Standard propeller included below 25 HP.

horsepower.description: Required unless model infers a single HP.

name: build_quote
